Title: Requires certain zoning changes that include the development of farmland or open spaces to be subject to approval under a referendum vote
Summary: Requires certain zoning changes that include the development of farmland or open spaces to be subject to approval under a referendum vote, approved by at least 60% of voters in the town, village, or city.
LawCode: Add §274-c, Town L; add §7-725-c, Vil L; add §27-c, Gen City L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the town law, the village law and the general city law, in relation to requiring certain zoning changes that include the development of farmland or open spaces to be subject to approval under a referendum vote
